column1: # The four plans: the site's form and the CLI's --plan. visibility and release follow from the plan; extended says
# whether r-cmd-check-extended starts on (off for a private internal package, to save minutes).
# checklists: the stage checklists (lists/stages.tsv, keys comma separated) the plan starts with. A package that gets
# all but qc needs no line in DESCRIPTION (Config/launchR/checklists).
